en.question: A retrieval-backed assistant returns a document the requesting user is not entitled to see. Where did the design fail?

options.text: The system prompt never mentioned the access control rules that apply.
options.note: A prompt cannot enforce entitlements against an over-broad query.

options.text: Retrieval was not filtered by the authenticated user's entitlements.
The model tier was not capable enough to reason about the permission model.
options.note: Permission enforcement is not a reasoning task for the model.

options.text: The document itself was not tagged with a confidential classification label.
options.note: Labels are metadata; the filter must actually be applied to the query.

en.explanation: Access control belongs in the retrieval layer, before content reaches the model. Once an unauthorised document is in context, telling the model to keep it secret is a probabilistic guard on a deterministic boundary.
